so_what.description: 2-4 sentence operator-language summary: what did this evidence actually teach us about the world?

next_actions.description: Concrete actions the team should take in the next 1-4 weeks given this evidence. Each item must be specific (not 'consider X').

practitioner_take.description: Would you commit resources on this evidence today? If yes, what guard rails? If no, what cheapest experiment flips your decision?

evidence_anchors.description: Specific pointers into worker_report metrics / baseline values / dialog entries that justify the scores. No anchors -> review is opinion, rejected.

cost_of_being_wrong.description: Optional but recommended. If we acted on this evidence and the claim turns out weaker than reported, what is the blast radius?

direct_methodology_for_user.description: Does this evidence hand the ORIGINAL problem-asker (intake user) a direct methodology to use? A technically-strong claim that doesn't translate into a usable methodology for the user must lower scores. See critics/PRACTITIONER_PERSONA.md for the contract.

methodology_summary.description: If verdict=provides: state the concrete procedure / decision rule the user can apply tomorrow. If verdict=partial: state what IS usable. If verdict=absent: state what the user would still have to figure out themselves.

gap_to_close.description: If verdict in {partial, absent}: name the smallest concrete step that would close the gap to a usable methodology. Empty string only when verdict=provides.
